purpose: Frozen event-time semantics, primary COM authority, H2 anchoring and measurement-comparator boundaries.

decisions.value: SYSTEM_COM (athlete + rigid 20 kg bar) = primary mechanics authority; ATHLETE_COM = secondary report/comparability signal
TAKEOFF_OCCURRENCE = the final transition from at least one active legal plantar support contact to zero active legal plantar support contacts, with interpolated/contact-event time if available
decisions.locator: Linear system authority section 12, physical takeoff (no RES-82 E-number label)
decisions.notes: This is the physical takeoff time used for H2 and takeoff velocity.

decisions.value: TAKEOFF_CONFIRMATION = a later fail-closed confirmation that bilateral geometric clearance exceeds the numerical guard, SYSTEM_COM_vz(TAKEOFF_OCCURRENCE) > 0, no prohibited contact exists, and no legal plantar recontact occurs throughout the genuine-flight dwell
decisions.locator: Linear system authority section 12, takeoff occurrence/confirmation split
decisions.sensitivity: dwell and clearance guard sensitivity required downstream
decisions.notes: If confirmation fails the candidate takeoff occurrence is rejected, never shifted.

decisions.statement: Confirmation must not shift the takeoff timestamp.
decisions.value: TAKEOFF_CONFIRMATION must never replace TAKEOFF_OCCURRENCE as the H2 time origin
decisions.locator: mission freeze item 10; system authority section 13
decisions.notes: Prevents a delayed-clearance threshold from artificially lowering H2.
Mandatory cross-checks: H_ballistic = vz_takeoff^2 / (2g); H_impulse from total vertical impulse / 99 kg.

decisions.value: starting from the candidate TAKEOFF_OCCURRENCE, zero legal plantar contacts must persist for at least 0.050 s; within the confirmation window both feet establish positive clearance above the numerical guard and no prohibited contact occurs
decisions.locator: Linear system authority section 12, genuine flight
decisions.notes: The 50 ms dwell is an engineering debounce, not a measured human constant.

decisions.value: clearance guard = max(2 mm, contact_margin + verified numerical penetration/error allowance); exact evaluated value sealed by RES-84
decisions.sensitivity: RES-84 seals exact value; guard participates in confirmation only
decisions.notes: The clearance guard is a confirmation tolerance, not the definition of the takeoff instant.

decisions.value: inside genuine flight, SYSTEM_COM_vz crosses positive -> nonpositive; compute the zero crossing by interpolation; no arbitrary apex dwell
first renewed valid plantar-floor contact after genuine flight; toe/forefoot-first is valid; body/bar-floor contact is not
decisions.locator: Linear system authority section 12, physical touchdown
decisions.notes: Landing absorption must be realized by the calibrated contact model and human joint motion, not a hidden vertical clamp.

decisions.value: bilateral per-foot vertical GRF threshold 10 N with 0.010 s persistence (the RES-82 F_thr convention; an equivalent total-GRF display may be reported) is comparator/diagnostic only and never defines the simulated physical event
decisions.locator: takeoff-threshold comparison study; RES-82 EVENT_CONTRACT F_thr
decisions.sensitivity: comparator threshold sensitivity is a reporting obligation

decisions.value: resampled at >=1000 Hz (1000 Hz canonical) with a documented anti-aliasing/filter path; raw native signals retained for independent recomputation
decisions.sensitivity: processing sensitivity is a reporting obligation
decisions.notes: Native simulator states/contacts remain event authority.

decisions.statement: Event chain and dwell semantics (with explicit takeoff supersession).

value.retained_from_RES82: E1-E12 chain, PHYSICAL_TIME dwell convention, negative controls, cross-event independence
value.superseded_for_successor: the clearance-gated historical takeoff anchor; for the successor the H2 time origin is TAKEOFF_OCCURRENCE (final legal plantar contact loss), and clearance/dwell survive only as TAKEOFF_CONFIRMATION
value.label_rule: RES-95 does not use RES-82 E-number labels for takeoff/flight/apex/touchdown so downstream readers cannot collide the two numbering systems

decisions.locator: RES-82 EVENT_CONTRACT_E1_E12.json; DWELL_SEMANTICS.json; Linear system authority section 12
decisions.sensitivity: downstream sensitivity execution owned by later RES
decisions.notes: This supersession is explicit so zero unresolved conflict remains between RES-82 labels and the controlling Linear takeoff semantics.

decisions.value: the H2 time origin is the last legal plantar contact loss; a later clearance-defined sample must never become the H2 origin
decisions.notes: This closes the historical delayed-takeoff defect class.
